records.reason: The monolithic entrypoint mixed orchestration, personal values, volatile facts, dependency authority, and review routing. Focused owners now provide direct triggers and versioned outputs.
Portable principles moved to their operational owners; duplicated workflow and delivery rules were deduplicated.
Named approval, build-versus-buy, decision card, graph, lockfile, update, removal, and rollback rules remain intact under one owner.
Stable language idioms are neutral guidance; personal library/framework winners are inactive configurable profile examples.
Stable capability IDs, active-host admission, collision, context, fallback, and no-auto-install replace installed-equals-approved routing.
Portable constraints, deterministic gates, and personal values no longer share one authority. Name-only contextual regex findings were retired.

Decision methods and durable personal direction were preserved. Unverified version, popularity, maturity, and winner claims were deliberately not copied as current authority; every future claim must enter a sourced, checked, expiring snapshot.
